itineraryReference.usage: Route and place-name context only. Actual EXIF capture dates and GPS take precedence over planned activities. The workbook itself is not included in the website.

dateSource: EXIF capture timestamps, using the camera-local calendar date rather than the UTC filename.
locationNotes: GPS tags were checked against the visible landmarks and itinerary. Region-level names are used where an exact landmark is uncertain.
The dervish venue is labelled only as Cappadocia; the venue name is not established.
itineraryDifferences: Kaş and Kaputaş photographs were captured on 1 May; Kekova and Demre photographs were captured on 2 May, opposite the main itinerary plan.
Balat, Fener, and the archaeological museums were photographed on 28 April; Kadıköy and Ortaköy were photographed on 9 May.
The Cappadocia sections follow the actual photo dates, which differ from some proposed activity lists in the workbook.
criteria: All 455 photographs reviewed in chronological contact sheets; shortlisted scenes compared at a larger size.
Blurred, obstructed, accidental, and repeated burst frames excluded. Transit photographs outside Turkey were not included.
Original framing and colour preserved. Web copies correct orientation, resize, and omit EXIF/XMP.

Prefer scenery and distinct details to posed personal portraits. Local people, public crowds, craftspeople, and performances are included with the owner’s permission. Short days retain fewer photographs when alternatives would be repetitive.
